title: Press Release: Sanofi’s Infilbray approved in the US as the first medicine to treat neurological manifestations of Type 3 Gaucher disease
summary:
Paris, November 18, 2026. The US Food and Drug Administration has approved Infilbray (venglustat), a novel, oral glucosylceramide synthase inhibitor (GCSi) that acts across the blood-brain barrier, for the treatment of neurological manifestations of Type 3 Gaucher disease (GD3) in adults and pediatric patients weighing at least 15 kg. GD3 is a rare lysosomal storage disorder that causes progressive systemic and neurologic decline, with central nervous system (CNS) manifestations.

title: Livsayis Becomes First siRNA Drug Approved for Generalized Myasthenia Gravis, Given as Just Four Shots a Year
summary:
Adults with the most common form of generalized myasthenia gravis now have a treatment given as an injection under the skin just four times a year. The Food and Drug Administration approved Regeneron's Livsayis (cemdisiran), the company announced Nov. 18. title: FDA OKs First Drug to Reduce Mortality in Niemann-Pick C
summary:
The FDA has approved adrabetadex (Lembaz; Mandos, LLC) injection to reduce mortality risk in adult and pediatric patients with infantile-onset Niemann-Pick disease type C (NPC), a rare and severe inherited disorder.

The approval was based on survival rates in 36 patients treated with the drug in three clinical trials. Those receiving the drug had a 55% reduction in mortality risk, and a longer median survival time than matched control individuals.

title: FDA Approves Infilbray, First Treatment for Neurological Symptoms of Type 3 Gaucher Disease
summary:
The U.S. Food and Drug Administration approved Infilbray (venglustat) tablets on 18 November 2026 as the first treatment for the neurological symptoms of Type 3 Gaucher disease, in adults and children weighing at least 15 kg. The approval, granted to Sanofi’s Genzyme Corporation seven days before the agency’s 25 November target date, rests on a 43-patient randomized trial and gives rare-disease investigators a fresh regulatory precedent.
